audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer reads Skill on all seven rows while the content layer and the packet read Zed/Zed/Zed/Zed/Zed/Zed/Katarina. Every row disagrees.
audit.why: Zed's Razor Shuriken is 900 range on a flat 6-second cooldown and costs energy, not health; Katarina's Q is 625. His lane phase is genuinely dominant and the win rate is carried by the late game, which the content layer already says.
audit.corrected: All seven full-layer sides moved to the content values with whys and ratings rewritten.

audit.why: spikes[] correctly place every early phase with Zed and the flip at two items. Death Mark is 120s at rank 1 and only 100s at rank 3 against your 45s Death Lotus at max rank — the ultimate economy inverts late.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] and spikes[1].text both claim Death Mark interrupts Death Lotus. It does not: Zed's R applies no crowd control at all — it makes HIM untargetable and applies a mark. Your channel continues; it simply has nothing to hit while he is untargetable.
audit.why: enemyKit R carries dash and untargetable flags and no hardCC flag, and Riot's text describes only untargetability, a dash and a delayed mark. ownerKit R is cancelled by CC, and Zed has none.
audit.corrected: Restated as: the untargetability wastes your channel rather than cancelling it, and the mark detonates 3 seconds later regardless.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT); dosFull[2].d invents a 'fifteen-second' Death Mark window.
audit.why: Death Mark is 120s at rank 1. Living Shadow is 20s down to 16s — the real punishable cooldown. Shadow Slash is 5s down to 3s and Razor Shuriken a flat 6s, which is why poke is constant.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[1].d is tradeGood verbatim and dontsFull[2].d is tradeBad verbatim (lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED); the pasted line references CC Zed does not have. The packet also flags 'Bouncing Blades' and 'Preparation daggers' — neither name exists in Katarina's kit text.
audit.why: Riot's description of Katarina's Q gives it no name in the kit file, and there is no ability called Preparation in her kit.
audit.corrected: Bullets rewritten to their titles; fabricated names replaced with the mechanic.

Play for exhaust or a jungler-assisted 2v1, and when he roams, crash the wave and take plates or follow instantly — a fed Zed bot lane loses you the game faster than your own lane does.

notes: All seven level-chart rows disagreed between layers: full read Skill everywhere, content and packet read Zed on six rows and Katarina at two items. All seven full sides moved to the content values as one atomic group with whys and ratings rewritten; no content win[N] edits were needed. The packet defect 'chart gives Zed 6/7 stages vs 1 against a 55.21% win rate' is not actually a contradiction here and I did not treat it as one — the content prose explains it explicitly: the win rate is earned entirely after two items, where her R reaches 45s and his stays at 100s. Corrected a real mechanical error the page stated twice: Death Mark does NOT interrupt Death Lotus. Zed's ultimate applies no crowd control anywhere in his kit — it grants HIM untargetability, so the channel continues and simply hits nothing. That distinction matters because it changes the counterplay from 'do not channel' to 'do not channel while he can still go untargetable, and keep a blink for the 3-second mark'. Killed 'Bouncing Blades' and 'Preparation daggers': neither name appears in Riot's text for Katarina's kit. Unverified and left alone: the item names in spikes[2] and late (Serrated Dirk, Eclipse, Hubris, Verdant Barrier, Zhonya's) — item data is not in the kits, and I did not add or change any of them. | COHERENCE: 5 chart edit(s) withdrawn — they moved the row to the enemy while leaving the phase why describing the owner winning it. Chart authority is an open question, so the label was reverted rather than the prose rewritten. Re-propose only as a side+why pair.
